MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 7
   D. 8

3. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 33
   C. 12
   D. 32

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 36

5. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 24
   C. 42
   D. 36

6. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 12
   D. 1

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 23
   C. 7
   D. 17

8. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

9. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 400

10. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 32
   D. 4

11. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 82
   C. 9
   D. 18

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. D — 144
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 12 × 12
3. Area = 144
Final Answer: 144 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

Working:

Final Answer: x = 7
